attributes.board_name: North Carolina Board of Examiners for Speech and Language Pathologists and Audiologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing professional education in the licensee's field sponsored by ASHA, the North Carolina Speech-Hearing-Language Association or the NC Department of Public Instruction, or other courses the Board approves as similar; the Board also accepts AAA registries and official college transcripts
rules.new_licensee_rule: Temporary licensees do not need CE during the Supervised Experience Year.
rules.audit_note: Licensees sign a compliance statement on the annual renewal; random audits; keep CE records for 5 years. Ambiguous courses may go to the monthly Board meeting for approval.
rules.notes: License renews every year, but CE is counted over a three-year cycle (Jan 1 of year one to Dec 31 of year three). Licensees may ask the Board once, in writing, to sync the cycle with their ASHA certification cycle. SLP and audiology assistants are registered by their supervising licensee and have no fixed CE hour requirement (21 NCAC 64 .1005/.1105). No mandatory topics.
rules.rule_quote: Beginning January 1, 2009 each licensee must complete 30 hours every three years of continuing professional education in their fields…
